scope: RERoT off, ordinary single-stream decode; CPU threads not restricted; same APEX weights, five RX6800, head-sharded, h0, MMVQ disabled, compact greedy sampling enabled
goal: Tighten the weight-only reference using independently timed operators and source-derived dependency/resource accounting; no whole-model duration or fitted residual may enter the independent reference. Improve actual runtime in independently confirmed comparisons.
inherited_evidence: Unreported run0335/run0605 operator measurements, sparse ledgers and parallel-submit confirmation must be audited and identified as inherited, not rerun claims.
selection: Exploratory only; among semantically valid finite outputs consider any point >=2% faster than the same-campaign parallel-reference for fresh four independent process-pair confirmation. Do not replace a failed point or silently drop fallback requests.
confirmation: A/B, B/A, A/B, B/A; 2 warm +3 measured +1 guard per process; primary pooled ms per public completion token; paired log ratio Student t df3 95%CI; report changed numerical trajectories rather than asserting byte equivalence.
safety: No driver/clock/power/watchdog/reset changes. Existing epoch/extent/integrity/ownership checks and timeouts retained. No concurrent GPU jobs or compilation. Stop a campaign on protocol/load/abnormal-exit failure and preserve evidence.
independent_reference: Replace accounted work rather than adding its service time to its old byte estimate. Count replicated and sharded tensors separately. Resource lower bounds use max, critical serial segments use sum; do not double count dispatch latency already inside operator measurements. Frozen models precede new model validation and retain explicit omitted costs. Component medians are an empirical implementation envelope, never a theorem of global hardware optimality.
